name: BeemBridge
subtitle: Redefining Seamless File Transfer
description: BeemBridge is an Electron.js desktop application designed for effortless, lightning-fast, and secure PC-to-PC file transfer over Wi-Fi. It eliminates the need for cables, flash drives, or complex network configurations, offering a convenient and reliable solution for moving data between devices.
roles: I designed and developed the frontend user interface.
I developed the cross-platform desktop application using GO wails.
I implemented the peer-to-peer networking using TCP & UDP Sockets.
I set up and managed the project's infrastructure.
I handled version control and management.

name: LocalRAGify
subtitle: Zero-Cost Local RAG Chatbot
description: LocalRAGify is a free, local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that combines open-source tools like OpenSearch and Ollama with a user-friendly chat interface powered by Streamlit. This project enables you to set up a cost-effective chatbot capable of answering queries using both retrieval and generative AI techniques, offering zero-cost local deployment, interactive responses via Ollama LLM, custom document retrieval with OpenSearch, and a seamless user experience.
roles: I integrated AI/ML models and developed the RAG system.
I designed and implemented data indexing and retrieval mechanisms.
I developed the frontend user interface using Streamlit.
I set up and managed the project's infrastructure.
I created the project documentation and article.
